title: Workspace Anatomy
subtitle: Immutable workflow IDs resolve to mutable slug directories that isolate files, generated media, CLI worktrees, and materialized skills
description: A source-backed anatomy of per-workflow workspaces: the database-backed id-to-slug resolver selects a DATA_DIR-rooted directory, contained consumers read and write artifacts through traversal-safe helpers, and CLI agents receive the workspace for worktrees and per-workflow skill discovery.

sourceRefs.reason: Canonical DATA_DIR, workspaces_dir, workspace_dir, and shipped example-workflow path rules.
Single immutable workflow-id to mutable slug translation and safe default-workspace policy.
Workflow service creation and injection of the resolved workspace directory into execution context.
Workflow rename path that moves a slug-keyed workspace directory.
Workspace file-serving and bounded upload routes using immutable workflow IDs and contained relative paths.
WorkspaceBackend and resolve_within path normalization, symlink/junction containment, and atomic write boundary.
Media references and reads/writes rooted in the executor-injected workspace.
Per-workflow .claude/skills materialization with support-file preservation and diff updates.
Per-node CLI worktree placement and workspace --add-dir behavior.

prompt.primaryRequest: Create a filesystem anatomy diagram showing how an immutable workflow ID resolves through workflow.db to a mutable slug-keyed workspace, what lives inside that workspace, and which HTTP, filesystem/media, and CLI-agent consumers access it through containment controls.
prompt.composition: Use three framed columns: Identity & Root Resolution, Per-Workflow Workspace, and Contained Consumers. Show the id→slug resolver as a vertical chain on the left; place the slug directory at the top of the middle frame with files, .claude skills, and per-task CLI worktrees below; stack HTTP routes, filesystem/media nodes, and the CLI agent on the right.
constraints: Label the on-disk directory with workflow.slug, never workflow.id
State that stable references and routes carry the immutable workflow id
Show containment for relative paths and symlink/junction escapes
Show CLI worktrees under the same workspace root
avoid: placing shipped example workflows under DATA_DIR
using a workflow id as the workspace directory name
